newsitem.title: USA: Univest raises qtly payout to $0.23.
newsitem.headline: Univest raises qtly payout to $0.23.

text.p: Univest Corp of Pennsylvania said directors declared a $0.23 per share quarterly cash dividend to be paid on January 2, to shareholders of record on December 12.
This an increase of 15 percent in the company's annual payout, it said.

Pointing out the company had previously paid a double dividend in the fourth quarter, a spokesman said the $0.23 payment represents an increase in the quarterly rate to $0.19 from the previous payment of $0.16 and combines the former annual extra dividend with quarterly dividends, resulting in a new quarterly rate of $0.23.
